title: 恩慕寺 Enmu Si
subtitle: a temple · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 12 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Temple of Gracious Remembrance (for Qianlong's mother)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a temple outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: built 1777 (S05 j76); burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207); the gate survives (S1200 lead)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: beside 恩佑寺 (S05 j76: 于恩佑寺之侧); point = the 恩佑寺 gate, offset unknown (C)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Two gates side by side on the road (S02 pp.104-105 photo captions). Just north of the pair the road crossed the 炉斗桥 (S02 p.105).

sources.text: Carroll Brown Malone, History of the Peking Summer Palaces under the Ch'ing Dynasty, Illinois Studies in the Social Sciences XIX, Urbana 1934; reprint Paragon 1966
